name: peeyush gupta
diagnosis: **पित्त दोष असंतुलन**: आपके शरीर में पित्त (अग्नि) की अधिकता है जिससे सीने में जलन, एसिडिटी, त्वचा पर चकत्ते और चिड़चिड़ापन होता है।
medicines: शतावरी चूर्ण (दिन में दो बार 1 चम्मच)
homeRemedies: सुबह खाली पेट एलोवेरा का रस पिएं।
सौंफ और धनिए की चाय पिएं।
तीखा, खट्टा और तला हुआ भोजन न करें।

name: priyanshi
diagnosis: **Vata-type Imbalance**: Based on your responses, your primary Dosha imbalance is VATA. Your symptoms (general complaint) are caused by accumulation of vata in the body channels (Srotas), disrupting the normal flow of Prana and tissue nutrition.
medicines: Ashwagandha Churna (1 tsp warm milk nightly)
homeRemedies: Warm sesame oil daily body massage
Warm milk with Ashwagandha and nutmeg at bedtime
Regular meal times — no skipping meals

name: keshav
diagnosis: **Vata-type Hair Loss (Khalitya — Vata Predominant)**: Classical Charaka Samhita describes Khalitya (baldness) as being caused primarily by Vata imbalance drying out the Asthi Dhatu (bone tissue, of which hair is a by-product). Vata depletes Sneha (lubrication) from hair roots causing thinning, breakage, and fall.
medicines: Bhringraj Taila (massage warm into scalp every night)
Ashwagandha Churna (1 tsp with warm milk at bedtime)
Narasimha Rasayana (1 tsp with milk — nourishes Asthi Dhatu)
Shatavari Churna (1 tsp with milk — rebuilds deep nourishing tissues)
homeRemedies: **Overnight Sesame-Bhringraj Scalp Mask**: Warm 3 tsp sesame oil + 1 tsp Bhringraj powder. Massage into scalp for 10 min, leave overnight, wash morning. 3x weekly.
**Onion Juice Scalp Rub**: Apply fresh onion juice to scalp, leave 30 min, wash. High sulfur content nourishes hair roots (Kesha Mula).
**Triphala Rinse**: Boil 2 tsp Triphala in 2 cups water for 15 min. Cool, strain and use as final hair rinse weekly.
**Diet Protocol**: Eat sesame seeds (1 tsp daily), coconut, soaked almonds, and iron-rich foods. Drink warm milk with Ashwagandha nightly. Avoid skipping meals.
therapies: **Shiroabhyanga (Head Massage)**: 20-min daily self-massage with warm Bhringraj or Brahmi oil — stimulates Marma points on the scalp, improves Vata circulation to hair roots.
**Shirodhara**: Warm medicated oil (Dhanwantharam Tailam) poured continuously on the forehead — profoundly calms Vata, nourishes the scalp channels (Kesha Srotas).
**Nasya (Anu Taila)**: 2 drops of Anu Taila in each nostril — carries nourishment directly to the scalp via nasal channels.
**Thalam / Tailapichhu**: Medicated oil kept on crown of head (held with cotton) for 45 minutes — deeply penetrates and lubricates hair follicles.

name: Rahul Kumar
diagnosis: **वात दोष असंतुलन**: आपके शरीर में वात (वायु) की अधिकता है जिससे दर्द, शुष्कता, कब्ज और घबराहट जैसे लक्षण उत्पन्न होते हैं।
medicines: अश्वगंधा चूर्ण (सोते समय दूध के साथ 1 चम्मच)
योगराज गुग्गुल (भोजन के बाद दिन में दो बार 2 गोली)
homeRemedies: रोजाना तिल के तेल से शरीर की मालिश करें।
सोते समय अश्वगंधा के साथ गर्म दूध लें।
हमेशा गर्म, ताजा और घी युक्त भोजन करें।
